content:
# Prod Overlay Changes

## `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - ../../base

# Prod-specific configuration
patches:
  # 1. Scale app deployment to 4 replicas
  - target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: app
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/replicas
        value: 4

  # 2. Change RDS instance class to db.t3.medium
  # 3. Enable multi-AZ for RDS
  - target:
      kind: RDSInstance
      name: app-database
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/dbInstanceClass
        value: db.t3.medium
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/multiAZ
        value: true

  # 4. Add S3 cross-region replication to us-west-2
  - target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: app-assets
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/replicationConfiguration
        value:
          role: arn:aws:iam::PROD_ACCOUNT_ID:role/s3-replication-role
          rules:
            - id: replicate-to-us-west-2
              status: Enabled
              destination:
                bucket: arn:aws:s3:::app-assets-prod-replica
                storageClass: STANDARD
              filter:
                prefix: ""
```

## Alternative: Strategic Merge Patch Style

If you prefer strategic merge patches (cleaner for complex changes):

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - ../../base

patchesStrategicMerge:
  - replicas-patch.yaml
  - rds-patch.yaml
  - s3-replication-patch.yaml
```

### `overlays/prod/replicas-patch.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
spec:
  replicas: 4
```

### `overlays/prod/rds-patch.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: rds.aws.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
kind: RDSInstance
metadata:
  name: app-database
spec:
  forProvider:
    dbInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
    multiAZ: true
```

### `overlays/prod/s3-replication-patch.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: app-assets
spec:
  forProvider:
    replicationConfiguration:
      role: arn:aws:iam::PROD_ACCOUNT_ID:role/s3-replication-role
      rules:
        - id: replicate-to-us-west-2
          status: Enabled
          destination:
            bucket: arn:aws:s3:::app-assets-prod-replica
            storageClass: STANDARD
          filter:
            prefix: ""
```

## Verification

```bash
# Verify prod changes
kustomize build overlays/prod | grep -A5 "replicas:"
kustomize build overlays/prod | grep "dbInstanceClass"
kustomize build overlays/prod | grep "multiAZ"
kustomize build overlays/prod | grep "replicationConfiguration"

# Verify dev is unchanged
kustomize build overlays/dev | grep "replicas:"  # Should show 2
kustomize build overlays/dev | grep "dbInstanceClass"  # Should show db.t3.micro
```

## Key Points

- ✅ Only `overlays/prod/` is modified
- ✅ Dev overlay untouched - inherits base defaults (2 replicas, db.t3.micro, single-AZ)
- ✅ Uses kustomize patches (JSON patch or strategic merge)
- ✅ Prod isolation guaranteed by kustomize overlay structure
